Our story

A shop built on fit and trust

I started this shop because I was tired of seeing men pay too much for clothes that fade in two washes. For 15 years our store has been about one thing: good fabric, honest price, proper fit.

Many of our customers first came with their fathers and now bring their own sons. We remember sizes, we remember tastes, and we will tell you straight if something does not suit you.

Whether it is a shirt for Monday or a full suit for a wedding, we take the same care with every customer who walks in.

  • Fabric checked by hand before it reaches the shelf
  • Fixed, fair prices with no bargaining games
  • Trial room and honest advice on fit
  • Quick alterations for hem and sleeve length
  • Easy exchange on unworn items
